INHERITANCE
Object <-  [basic/valid]
IO <- Object [basic/valid]
Int <- Object [basic/valid]
String <- Object [basic/valid]
Bool <- Object [basic/valid]
A <- Object [user/valid]
B <- A [user/valid]
Main <- B [user/valid]

B ATTRIBUTES
0 A.x : Object inherited=true
1 B.y : Int inherited=false

B DISPATCH
0 Object.abort self=false override=
1 Object.type_name self=false override=
2 Object.copy self=true override=
3 B.f self=true override=A.f

LOOKUP Object -> A -> B
